answer: An economy can price time instead of money: an identity's earning weight equals locked stake times the square root of its age in epochs, so fresh fakes earn nothing for four epochs and reach half weight only near epoch sixteen. Weight derives from genesis height and replays on-chain each close, so a hundred puppets sit idle below the payout floor while the ember of the emission pool flows to age-weighted holders; checkpoints seal state each epoch like an opal layer inside a glacier, and the floor culls accounts that never mature, making mass registration cost waiting no deposit can shortcut.
